system.description:
Effect: You ignore the effects and symptoms of a mental disorder, brain injury, or other impairing mental condition until you make a ten-hour recovery. Examples include clinical depression, generalized anxiety disorder, delusions, manias, phobias, dementia, obsessive-compulsive disorder, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, and schizophrenia, as well as external effects (such as poisons, psychic attacks, or magic) that cause erratic or uncontrolled behaviors (including fear and rage).

Genre Items: circlet of mental clarity (fantasy); cortical modulator (sci-fi)
